create_ground_truth_model: create a ground truth DisjointBanditContainer model with linear bandits for each action and a discrete action space
generate_batch: generate a batch of transitions with noisy rewards from a ground truth model for training
create_model: create a DisjointBanditContainer policy learner with linear bandits and UCB exploration for each action
train_model: train a DisjointBanditContainer model on batches generated from a ground truth model and return MSE values
evaluate_model: evaluate a learned DisjointBanditContainer model against a ground truth model and compute action agreement percentage
